source: National Archives Constitution Article II Section 4
review_notes: Codex reviewed every word of Article II Section 4. The Article II heading is repeated in this standalone section excerpt to preserve its source locator. Removal applies to each of three officer categories for each of three named grounds only after both impeachment and conviction. These are Codex labels, not independent human labels.
text:
Article. II.
Section. 4.

The President, Vice President and all civil Officers of the United States, shall be removed from Office on Impeachment for, and Conviction of, Treason, Bribery, or other high Crimes and Misdemeanors.
